name: nz-payroll-notices-filing-penalties
description: Use this skill for New Zealand employer payroll obligations after PAYE is worked out, for paydays from 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027: student-loan recovery notices (SLCIR) and voluntary extra deductions, employee child-support deduction notices and protected earnings, District Court attachment orders, Inland Revenue tax-arrears deduction notices, payday filing of employment information, paying deductions to Inland Revenue, correcting employment information, keeping PAYE records, late and non-electronic filing penalties, and late payment and non-payment penalties. Trigger on deduction notice, child support deduction, attachment order, arrears notice, protected earnings, payday filing, employment information, IR348, payroll correction, PAYE penalty. PAYE itself is in nz-employer-payroll.
